items.description: Landlord must install, at its own cost, the Landlord's Initial Installations (metering equipment, cage walls and innerducts).
items.span_text: A. Landlord shall at its sole cost and expense cause (collectively, “Landlord’s Initial Installations”):

items.description: Landlord must install a hot-aisle containment system at its own cost per an agreed layout, with later layout changes paid by Tenant.
items.span_text: The installation of hot-aisle containment system, per a layout that is reasonably agreed on by Landlord and Tenant, at Landlord’s sole cost and expense; provided, however, that Tenant acknowledges that once the layout is determined, any changes shall be at Tenant’s sole cost and expense.

items.description: Tenant must reimburse Landlord for Systems Installations fees above the Landlord-funded amount, up to a capped amount, within thirty days after receiving an invoice.
items.span_text: Landlord hereby agrees that Landlord’s Systems Installations shall be at Landlord’s cost, up to $[***], and Tenant hereby agrees to reimburse Landlord for any such Installation Fee that exceeds $[***], up to but not to exceed $[***], within thirty (30) days following Tenant’s receipt of an invoice therefor.

items.description: Landlord must provide a twelve-month warranty against defects in its installation of the hot-aisle containment system and Landlord's Systems Installations.
items.span_text: Landlord shall provide a twelve (12) month warranty with regard to defects in Landlord’s installation of the (collectively, the “Landlord’s Warranty Installations”) hot-aisle containment system and the Landlord’s System Installations (“Landlord’s Warranty”).

items.description: Landlord must perform its installations in a good and workmanlike manner and in compliance with applicable laws.
items.span_text: Landlord’s Installations shall be performed: (i) in a good and workmanlike manner, and (ii) in compliance with all Applicable Laws; and

items.description: Landlord must correct or repair a warranty breach at no cost to Tenant as soon as conditions reasonably permit.
items.span_text: Landlord shall, at no cost to Tenant, correct or repair such breach as soon as conditions reasonably permit
items.trigger: If, on or before the Warranty Expiration Date, as hereinafter defined, Tenant gives Landlord written notice of any breach of Landlord’s Warranty promptly after Tenant becomes aware of such breach

items.name: Warranty Expiration Date
items.span_text: The “Warranty Expiration Date” shall be defined as the date twelve (12) months after the Commencement Date.

items.description: Landlord must provide the service levels listed in Table A, including electricity threshold, battery capacity, back-up power and HVAC specifications.
